name: taisce-memory
description: Memory that outlives the session, backed by a Taisce deployment: recall what was decided with the words behind it, and record decisions so the next session starts informed.

endpoint.title: Taisce endpoint
endpoint.description: Base URL of the deployment, without a trailing slash. The plugin appends /mcp.

token.title: Credential
token.description: A write-enabled credential for one project. It is scoped, revocable and audited, which is why the plugin asks for one rather than running an OAuth flow.

data_subject_id.title: Data subject
data_subject_id.description: Who these sessions are about, as registered with the deployment. Leave empty for project-wide memory.

auto_capture.title: Record turns automatically
auto_capture.description: OFF by default, deliberately: turning it on sends the user's message of every completed turn to the deployment. Leave it off and use /taisce-memory:remember for what is worth keeping.
